justification: HOLY COW, folks, this lineup card writes itself! Swift and Henry already banked their work from Thursday night in Chicago - twenty-one and twelve-eight, lock those numbers in and tip your cap - and now Sunday's crew rolls out right behind 'em: Aaron Rodgers slinging it for the Steelers, Bijan Robinson getting the rock early and often in Atlanta, Zay Flowers and Jordan Addison stretching the field, and Isaiah Likely still my favorite tight end to say out loud. Boswell's in at kicker for real now - no more mystery man holding that spot, we are a FULL ballclub for the first time in weeks! I got a couple fellas restin' on the bench with a Lamar Jackson 'Out' tag and a Deebo Samuel 'Out' tag, but buddy, I didn't need to touch either one, my starters are healthy and rarin' to go - that's a load off a broadcaster's mind. Let's play two, Kim's bunch, here we come!
